events.quote: > March 2024: Eurobonds consisting of €850 million guaranteed Notes paying 3.750% coupon and maturing in 2031.
events.summary: easyJet raised a new guaranteed Eurobond under its EMTN programme, extending its debt maturity profile and supporting liquidity.
events.title: Eurobond issued under EMTN programme

events.quote: The Committee reviewed easyJet's credit rating position and noted the upgrade of rating from
events.summary: The Group's credit rating was upgraded during the year, supporting its investment grade standing and access to financing.
events.title: Credit rating upgraded by agency

events.quote: In May, we finalised the acquisition of the SR Technics Malta maintenance facility and welcomed 400 highly skilled and valued new colleagues.
events.summary: easyJet acquired its long-standing maintenance provider in Malta, bringing skilled engineering staff in-house to support operational standards.
events.title: Acquisition of SR Technics Malta maintenance facility

events.quote: 16 NEO aircraft joined the fleet, with a further 299 on order.
events.summary: New NEO aircraft joined the fleet during the year, lowering fuel burn and emissions while a large order book remains for future deliveries.
events.title: Fleet renewal with NEO aircraft deliveries

events.quote: Unfortunately, despite easyJet being fully prepared for this summer, we saw operational challenges outside of our control, in particular with air traffic control (ATC), which was the single biggest source of delays this year
events.summary: Air traffic control underperformance, strikes and weather caused significant delays, prompting schedule changes and investment in spares to protect reliability.
events.title: Air traffic control disruption and weather hit operations

events.quote: Given the performance in the financial year alongside easyJet's strong liquidity position, the Board intends to pay an increased dividend of 12.1 pence per share, up 169% and equivalent to 20% of FY24's headline profit after tax.
events.summary: The Board proposed a substantially increased ordinary dividend reflecting strong performance and liquidity, with excess capital returns to be assessed separately.
events.title: Increased ordinary dividend to shareholders
